interpretation: Operator observation, not a measurement of the slowdown's cause. Cumulative CPU seconds count from each process's start, not current load; the reported clock is a single WMI reading. No system setting or process was changed during the campaign. The measured slowdown itself is derivable from the fit records: median seconds per target call, continuation over pilot, ranged from 0.82 to 2.23 by target and arm and rose with position in the target-major schedule (independent results review, item 5).
method: Get-Process sorted by cumulative CPU seconds (top 8)
observed_by: Fable orchestrator, from the PowerShell tool in the Claude Code session that launched the batches
observed_utc_precision: approximate; taken immediately after the 00:07:55 UTC progress check, while batch 1 was running its multisensory cells
